Green sage and verbena give way to a rich floral heart of rose and tuberose, anchored by mossy, earthy patchouli and vetiver.
Sparkling mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper lead to rose and peony with a powdery softness. Musk, vanilla and cashmere wood leave it smooth and gentle.
